'''Laundry droids''' were a type of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that were responsible for doing the laundry. They were known to be used extensively on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="DR">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref>
